channel.title: Deep Press Analysis
channel.description: Independent research into corporate power, global governance, financial systems, geopolitical risk, and economic dependencies.

item.title: Q3 2026 Signals: AI Capital Rotation, Export Controls, and Software-Defined Warfare
item.description: An analysis of third-quarter 2026 investment signals, highlighting the structural rotation toward AI energy infrastructure, the transition to Silicon Domicile export controls, and the Pentagon's shift toward software-defined warfare.

item.title: Fiat Architecture: Endogenous Money, Central Bank Operations, and the CBDC Threat
item.description: A structural deconstruction of modern fiat systems, outlining the mechanics of endogenous money creation by commercial banks, central bank balance sheet operations, and the fiscal risks of Quantitative Easing.

item.title: The Deferred Asset: Federal Reserve Mechanics, Seigniorage, and Digital Liquidity
item.description: An in-depth structural analysis of Federal Reserve monetary operations, examining the mechanics of physical currency issuance, digital liquidity management, endogenous bank credit, and the deferred asset accounting mechanism.

item.title: Technocratic Authority: Sovereign Debt, AI Narratives, and Electoral Engineering
item.description: An institutional analysis of the global media landscape, examining how narratives around US sovereign debt, the AI race, and domestic electoral engineering are framed to legitimize centralized authority and technocratic governance.

item.title: Shadow Logistics Architecture: Sanctions Evasion, Crypto-Clearing, and the Shadow Fleet
item.description: A structural analysis of global sanctions evasion networks, detailing the shift to decentralized transit hubs, crypto-laundering systems, and shadow fleets, alongside extraterritorial regulatory responses.

item.title: Media Reality Construction: Narrative Framing, Executive Power, and Institutional Shifts
item.description: An institutional analysis of media reality construction across leading Western publications, detailing the narrative shift toward the normalization of coercive state actions and executive dominance.

item.title: Soviet Collapse: Capital Flight, Rent Capture, and Sovereign Default
item.description: A forensic analysis of Soviet capital flight, sovereign assets, rent capture, offshore financial structures, and the economic mechanisms behind the USSR's institutional collapse.

item.title: Narrative Power: TikTok, GLP-1 Drugs, Quebec, and the Semiconductor Divide
item.description: An institutional analysis of algorithmic media control, GLP-1 biopolitics, economic determinism in Quebec, and the geoeconomic fragmentation of the semiconductor industry.

item.title: Media Narratives, AI Lobbying, and the Redistribution of Global Risk
item.description: An investigative analysis of the transatlantic media divide, corporate lobbying in artificial intelligence, and systemic risk redistribution across maritime and defense sectors.

item.title: The AI Hardware-Energy Shock: Supply Chains Are Starting to Fracture
item.description: PCB manufacturing scandals, chemical plant shutdowns, transformer steel shortages, and AI infrastructure demand point toward a growing hardware-energy bottleneck in the global economy.

item.title: The New Global Debt Architecture: Financial Repression, mBridge, and BRICS Pay
item.description: A systemic analysis of sovereign debt monetization, financial repression, fragmented global liquidity, BRICS Pay, mBridge, and the emergence of alternative clearing infrastructure.

item.title: Hormuz, Iran, and Ukraine: How Regional Crises Become a Global Energy Shock
item.description: A strategic assessment of the Iran crisis, disruption around the Strait of Hormuz, global energy exposure, and the expanding Russia-Iran military relationship affecting the war in Ukraine.

item.title: America Rewrites the AI Export-Control System
item.description: U.S. export controls are shifting from company-specific bans toward systemic management of AI chips, critical minerals, cloud providers, domestic allocation rules, and semiconductor supply chains.

item.title: Defense Capital Rotates: Critical Minerals, Military Contracts, and the AI Short
item.description: A strategic assessment of U.S. critical-mineral localization, major defense contracts, institutional capital rotation, AI short positioning, and renewed exposure to housing.
